QuestInfo.name: [10th Anniversary] To the Festival Spot!
QuestInfo.0: Now that the 10th Anniversary is on, go meet with Manager Mush, go-to guy for the festival.
QuestInfo.2: You got the #i2432708# #b#t2432708##k! This will take you right to the 10th Anniversary Festival Spot, where you can talk to Manager Mush.
QuestInfo.1: Use the #b10th Anniversary Teleport Rock#k to reach the 10th Anniversary Festival Spot and talk to #b#p9000291##k.

0.0: Hello, hello, #h0#! I'm #bManager Mush#k. I'm sure you know about Maple World's 10th birthday. Well, us mushrooms want to throw a festival to celebrate it.
0.1: Humans and mushrooms alike are all pitching in to set up, so I'd really appreciate it if you could lend a hand. Right now, I'm currently at the #b#m910196000##k. Tell ya what, I'll give you this #b#i2432708# #t2432708##k so you can zip right over. Interested?

yes.0: Thank you, #h0#. Use the #b#i2432708# #t2432708##k to get to #b#m910196000##k quickly. Just remember, you can only use it once every 10 minutes.

no.0: From here, you can get back to most towns using the dimensional portal. It's no hassle, so why not help us with the preparations?

1.0: Ahh, here you are, #h0#! I'll give you the rundown on what you can do for the festival. Talk to me when you're ready to begin.
1.1: For your information, if you lose the #i2432708##b #t2432708##k, use the quest notifier on the left or talk to me to #bget another one#k. Don't sweat it if you've lost it! We got piles of 'em!
